source_claim: AlphaEvolve can spend long parallelized evaluation budgets, including roughly hundred-compute-hour solutions, while tracking overall compute budget and ablation performance by budget fraction
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has local cooperative budget controls for generations, evaluations, evaluator seconds, wall-clock runtime, logical LLM calls, provider attempts, provider tokens, configured provider cost, retained LLM latency, staged sample/retry/timeout counters, stage/sample wall-clock limits, runtime budget snapshots, controller budget-event replay, LLM budget reports, and full-runtime restore budget pre-application. It does not claim per-candidate compute-hour accounting, worker or accelerator lease accounting, async queue budget accounting, queued/running/completed long-evaluation state, partial expensive evaluation checkpoint/resume, wall-clock versus compute-hour compression, or equal-budget benchmark execution reports.
